_meta.what: Curated real-device catalog for the KS_DEVICE morphing sampler — coherent per-model tuples INCLUDING the fields Playwright's device registry omits (webgl_renderer, cores, memory). Fills the gap: Playwright descriptors carry UA/screen/DPR/touch but no GPU/cores/memory, and are mobile-heavy — so a morphed desktop or a GPU-coherent device needs this.
coherence_rules: webgl_renderer/webgl_vendor are the exact UNMASKED_* strings a real Chrome/Safari reports for that GPU (see sources).
Chrome desktop wraps GPUs in ANGLE: 'ANGLE (<vendor>, <renderer> Direct3D11 ...)' on Windows, 'ANGLE (Apple, ANGLE Metal Renderer: Apple Mx, ...)' on Apple Silicon.
navigator.deviceMemory is CAPPED at 8 and quantized to {0.25,0.5,1,2,4,8}: >=8GB reports 8, 4-6GB reports 4.
navigator.deviceMemory is UNDEFINED on Safari/iOS — omit it (a value would be incoherent). iOS webgl_renderer is the masked 'Apple GPU'.
hardwareConcurrency = logical cores as Chrome reports them (desktop 4/8/12/16, Android typically 8).
screen.{w,h} are CSS pixels (post-DPR): Windows desktop DPR 1.0, Apple Retina DPR 2.0, phones 2.0-3.0.
engine: chromium devices are Android/desktop-Chrome; webkit devices are iPhone/iPad (drive with KS_ENGINE=webkit so the engine and UA agree).

GPU CAPS are real-silicon, not a string: MAX_TEXTURE_SIZE must match the claimed GPU. The webgl_renderer STRING morphs cleanly (main-realm patch), but a software backend (SwiftShader = 8192) betrays a high-end GPU: br.mobile_gpu_caps_mismatch fires on Adreno 7xx / Mali-G7x (real 16384), and faking the value up trips br.webgl_maxtexture_unallocatable (you can't allocate what you claim). So ON A SOFTWARE-GL HOST only LOW-END mobile GPUs (Adreno 5xx, real 8192) morph TRULY coherently; higher tiers need real 16384-capable silicon (real-hardware-bound). max_texture_size below records the tier.
_meta.verification: Screen/DPR/webgl are from verified public sources; cores/memory follow documented Chrome caps. Before a live engagement, CONFIRM each tuple against a real headful capture (harness/tools/headful_capture.mjs) — this DB is the curated starting corpus; the capture is the coherence gate.
